description: Turn a written shift handoff checklist into one shift handoff voice clip per labeled cue. This shift handover voice studio records each handover checklist audio and shift change voice from the list the desk already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 shift handoff clip files. Use it for shift handoff voice packs that keep one cue on each clip.
